statement: ∀ (s : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous g → Function.Periodic g 1 → (∀ t, 0 ≤ g t) → intervalIntegral (fun t => Real.exp (s*Real.cos (2*Real.pi*t))*g (2*t)) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume ≤ Real.cosh s * intervalIntegral (g) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume

plain_statement.zh: 倍增映射下，剥去一层余弦指数权
plain_statement.en: Remove one exponential cosine weight under doubling

brief.zh: 把周期分成两半。两支上的余弦互为相反数，指数权平均为 cosh(s cos x)，再用 |cos x|≤1。
brief.en: Pair the two inverse branches. Their exponential weights average to cosh(s cos x), bounded by cosh s. The remaining weight may be any nonnegative continuous periodic function.
